All Countries Invaded by America 🇺🇸

So much for isolationism. 53 present-day countries where U.S. forces landed, occupied, struck, or backed a coup — from half of Mexico to Vietnam. Including Operation Condor across South America, and the 2026 strikes on Venezuela.

Did America come to yours? 👇
